authentication_boundary: Locally minted valid signed session cookie accepted by normal require_session. This is not a password-login test or production access proof.
selection: Frozen before contact scoring; no record replaced after outcomes. Source-backed native records are not independently verified distinct eligible physical opportunities.
privacy: Published company method values and representative names are hashed here; exact values remain in protected local API evidence and the cited official source. No workbook cell data exported.

review_corrections.basis: Independent review distinguished 25 primary project-route occurrences from 21 unique primary company IDs. The original aggregation also included four additional person-association identities. Source artifacts, frozen project selection and per-project values remain unchanged.

identity_consolidation_at_measurement.finding: Each TDLR representative has a different company identity ID from its same-project organization route despite matching source organization text. Historical identities are not merged to improve metrics. A conservative source-bound linkage repair is being tested separately.

limits: Authenticated local API calls are not production API or authentication proof.
The API company route reflects source-reported operator/owner attribution, not verified purchasing authority or independently adjudicated entity accuracy.
Twenty company-discovery outcomes were unresolved after bounded fetch timeout; five remained slot-deferred/interrupted. Missing is not a concluded absence of public contacts.
A source-published Owner Phone is a company route, never a named representative's personal method.
ACTION NOW is discovery-call priority; it supplies none of the strict commercial-actionability numerator.
Construction estimates and permit dates are not power-need dates. Unknown load/supply/gap remain null, not zero.
No paid-provider activation, production mutation, merge or deployment was performed by this measurement.
